title: Status update: lock screen
description: A phone lock screen on the dark ground with a single email notification whose subject reads "Status update." No clock, sender, airline or other text: the preview lines are grey bars and the app icon a plain envelope.
source: The brief (Nov 2026). Icons: Lucide (ISC). Wallpaper: ../_brand/bg-dark.jpg blurred.

fields.label: Subject
fields.hint: The email's subject line, the only text on the screen. One line; about 20 characters.
